Transport differs from the producer's by design: the CNF bytes stayed in parent memory and reached the solver and drat-trim through separate anonymous pipes (/dev/fd/N); the producer used a reused scratch CNF file. The proof went through a per-instance FIFO to drat-trim stdin with -i, as in the producer's r4. The parent holds a FIFO write end until the solver is reaped (no early EOF, no blocking open).
